Name: Country Emily
Author: monteso
Description:
Combining the ideas from two of my other mods ExtremeMakeover Emily and Country Haley. I have made made Emily into a country girl ready for life on the farm. Blue flannel shirt, bluejeans, a little bird companion to sit on her shoulder plus four hair variants. Enough options to really customise Emily the way you like.

Thanks to Vigo1308 for their emily retexture that inspired me and started all this.

WARNING: DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD ANY OTHER PLACE THAN NEXUSMODS. WWW.STARDEWVALLEYMODS.NET STEALS MY AND OTHER PEOPLE'S MODS AND UPLOADS
THEM ON THEIR WEBSITE WITHOUT PERMISSION. DON'T DOWNLOAD OUR MODS THERE

[u][b]Install info[/b]
[/u] Open the 7z file in 7-zip, Pick only one portrait verison to use, place the Character and Portrait files into the appropriate file locations. StardewValley/Content/Portraits and Content/Characters.

[u]Install info Content Patcher pack only

[/u][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download mod pack  and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[*]Open Config file, select portrait verison. Use pics as reference
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
